en.name: Corn syrup
en.summary: Corn syrup keeps about 3 years in a cupboard, tightly covered. It is too sugary and too low in water for bacteria to grow in, so what ends a bottle is mould around a sticky neck or a sugar crust, not spoilage in the usual sense.
en.pantry: Store it tightly capped in a cool, dry cupboard, where it keeps about 3 years. Sugar syrups this concentrated hold their water so tightly that microbes cannot use it, which is why the bottle is not a refrigerated food and why a half-used one is no more fragile than a new one. The two things that do end a bottle are contamination and crystallisation: a wet or used spoon dipped into the neck brings in moisture that dilutes the surface just enough for mould to take hold, and a sticky, badly closed cap grows the same thing around the rim.
en.fridge: Refrigeration is optional and extends storage life, but no separate refrigerated timeline is published for corn syrup, so work to the cupboard figure. Cold makes the syrup far more viscous and slow to pour and encourages sugar crystals around the neck, so most kitchens are better off keeping the bottle in the cupboard and simply keeping it clean and closed. If you do refrigerate it, stand the bottle in warm water for a few minutes before you try to measure anything out.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for corn syrup and no reason to invent one. It will not freeze solid at household freezer temperatures — it goes stiff and unusable instead — and there is nothing to gain, because a capped bottle is already stable for years in a cupboard. Freezer space is better spent on something perishable.
spoilage: Mould, usually a fuzzy spot at the neck or under the cap rather than in the body of the syrup.
A fermented, alcoholic or yeasty smell.
Cloudiness or a haze running through what should be clear syrup.
Hard sugar crystals through the bottle that will not redissolve in warm water.
tips: Wipe the neck and the screw thread before recapping; that is where mould starts.
Never dip a used or wet spoon in — pour instead.
Stand a crystallised bottle in warm water and stir to bring it back.
Keep it away from the hob; heat darkens the syrup over time.

faq.q: Does corn syrup need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: No. A tightly capped bottle keeps about 3 years in the cupboard. Refrigerating extends storage life but makes the syrup thick and hard to pour.

faq.q: How can you tell if corn syrup has gone bad?
faq.a: Look for mould at the neck or under the cap, a fermented smell, or cloudiness. Crystals on their own are not spoilage.
There is no timeline for it and no benefit. It stiffens rather than freezing, and the cupboard already keeps it for years.

zh.name: 玉米糖漿
zh.summary: 玉米糖漿蓋緊放櫥櫃約可放 3 年。它太甜、水分太少，細菌根本活不了；終結一瓶糖漿的通常是瓶口長霉或整瓶結晶，而不是一般意義上的腐敗。
zh.pantry: 蓋緊放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃，約可放 3 年。這種濃度的糖漿把水分綁得很牢，微生物用不到，所以它不是冷藏食品，用了一半的瓶子也不會比新的脆弱。真正會毀掉一瓶的是兩件事：污染與結晶。沾濕或用過的湯匙伸進瓶口，會帶進水分，把表面稀釋到剛好夠霉菌立足；瓶口黏答答又沒蓋緊，也會在螺紋處長出同樣的東西。
zh.fridge: 冷藏是可選的，可以延長保存，但並沒有另外公布的冷藏期限，所以請以櫥櫃那個數字為準。低溫會讓糖漿黏稠到很難倒出來，瓶口也更容易結糖粒，因此多數家庭把它放櫥櫃、保持乾淨並蓋緊，反而比較實際。真的要冰的話，量取之前先讓瓶子泡一下溫水。
zh.freezer: 玉米糖漿沒有冷凍期限，也沒有必要冷凍。家用冷凍庫的溫度並不會讓它結成硬冰，只會變得又硬又難用；而且也沒好處，因為蓋好的瓶子本來就能在櫥櫃放好幾年。冷凍庫的空間留給容易壞的東西比較划算。
spoilage: 長霉，通常是瓶口或瓶蓋內側的一小塊絨毛，而不是糖漿本體。
聞起來有發酵味、酒味或酵母味。
本該透明的糖漿變得混濁或起霧。
整瓶結出泡溫水也化不開的硬糖晶。
tips: 蓋回去之前先擦乾淨瓶口與螺紋，霉就是從那裡開始的。
不要把用過或沾濕的湯匙伸進去，用倒的。
結晶的瓶子泡溫水並攪拌，就能恢復。
遠離爐台，長期受熱會讓糖漿顏色變深。

faq.a: 不用。蓋緊放櫥櫃約可放 3 年。冷藏可以延長保存，但會變得又稠又難倒。

faq.q: 怎麼判斷玉米糖漿壞了？
faq.a: 看瓶口或瓶蓋內側有沒有霉、聞有沒有發酵味、糖漿是不是變混濁。單純結晶不算壞掉。
沒有相關期限，也沒有好處。它不會真的結冰，只會變硬；櫥櫃本來就能放很多年。
